in_marathi.name: Sharvan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Peace
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sharvan', which refers to the God of Peace. In Hindu mythology, Sharvan is believed to bring peace and tranquility to those who bear his name.
